env.label: 🧪 测试 Google Maps API (直接)
🧪 测试 SearchV2 - 东京拉面店 summary
env.command:
cd wanderlog_api && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/places/ai/search-v2 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"东京拉面店","language":"zh"}' | python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys,re
j=json.load(sys.stdin)
places=j.get('places') or []
pat=re.compile(r'^以.+为亮点')
print('places:',len(places))
for i,p in enumerate(places[:10],1):
    s=(p.get('summary') or '').strip()
    isfb=bool(pat.search(s)) or ('整体氛围' in s and '为亮点' in s)
    print(f"{i:02d} fallback={isfb} {p.get('name','')[:40]} | {s}")
PY
